action: Konka alone on the plain backdrop, finger up, squinting at us. Slow push-in.
line: So... you can't control your lust?

action: Someone (Christy, just walking by) crosses the frame. Konka's head snaps to follow; his to-do list slips out of his hand.
line: One attractive person walks past, and suddenly your brain forgets every important thing you were supposed to do today.

action: Snap-zoom on his face: dazed, dopey grin. Nobody home.
line: Congratulations. Your hormones have officially taken over management.

action: Chapter card: title slams in on the left, Konka thinking on the right.
line: First, get yourself a purpose.

action: Hard cut to a deadpan stare into the lens. Hold.
line: Seriously.

action: Finger up, eyes up: the idea lands. Determined.
line: Find something you actually want to achieve.

action: Konka slumped on the floor doing nothing; push in as his eyes slide sideways and a sly smirk creeps in.
line: Because when your entire day consists of doing absolutely nothing, your brain has plenty of time to entertain some very questionable ideas.

action: Chapter card. Konka arms crossed, pleased with himself.
line: Second, work on yourself.

action: Jump cut 1: squatting, heaving a dumbbell up.
line: Hit the gym.

action: Jump cut 2: on the floor at the laptop (side-on, screen toward him), typing.
line: Learn a skill.

action: Jump cut 3: kneeling, finishing a wonky birdhouse.
line: Build something.

action: Close-up: total focus, brow down.
line: Give your brain something productive to obsess over.

action: Three push-ups (held poses on the counts), then he flops.
line: And no, doing three push-ups

action: Back view at the mirror, checking his round tummy, very satisfied.
line: and checking your abs in the mirror doesn't count as a transformation.

action: Chapter card. Konka, finger up, arms crossed.
line: Third, stop entertaining every thought that enters your head.

action: A thought bubble pops up beside his head; he holds up a flat hand to it: no.
line: Just because your brain suggests something doesn't mean you have to follow through.

action: Night (backdrop goes dark): Konka on the floor with an entire pizza, delighted.
line: Your brain also tells you to eat an entire pizza at midnight.

action: Mid-bite freeze, guilty side-eye to the lens.
line: Doesn't mean it's a genius.

action: Chapter card. Konka explaining.
line: Fourth, stop feeding the temptation.

action: Insert (its own drawing): big hand, phone tilted, a profile page (no photo shown, just tiles). Thumb hovers.
line: You know that account you keep checking?

action: Caught. Nervous grin, hands together, eyes darting.
line: Yeah. That one.

action: Insert: the thumb taps; FOLLOWING flips to FOLLOW.
line: Unfollow it.

action: Pull out: Konka on the floor, hands up, surrounded by five phones all showing feeds.
line: You can't complain about being distracted while deliberately surrounding yourself with distractions.

action: Chapter card. Konka, smug finger.
line: Finally, practice self-discipline.

action: Jump cut 1: one tiny step forward. Proud.
line: Start small.

action: Jump cut 2: he chalks a line on the floor and stands behind it, arms crossed.
line: Set boundaries.

action: Jump cut 3: he points at a routine checklist, three ticks.
line: Stick to a routine.

action: Sincere beat: relaxed open shrug, warm smile.
line: And remember, feeling attraction is completely normal.

action: Gag: Konka goes stiff as a robot, blank eyes. Held.
line: The goal isn't to become a robot.

action: Callback to shot 2: the same person walks past behind him. This time he stays on his work. Small smile.
line: It's to stop letting every passing impulse make your decisions.

action: Slow push-in on Konka, calm, serious, to the lens.
line: Because if you can't control your attention...

action: His phone lights up on the floor. His head turns to it on its own. Cut to black.
line: Something else will.
